ordinary.intro_inv:
V/ O Lord, thou wilt open my lips.
R/ And my mouth shall declare thy praise.
ordinary.intro:
V/ O God, come to my assistance.
R/ O Lord, make haste to help me.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
Alleluia.

ordinary.gloria:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, *
  and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, *
  and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
ordinary.dismissal:
! When a priest or deacon presides, he dismisses the people with a blessing. Otherwise:
May the Lord bless us, and defend us from all evil, and bring us to life everlasting.
R/ Amen.
ordinary.conclusion:
V/ Let us bless the Lord.
R/ Thanks be to God.
ordinary.examen: ! A brief examination of conscience may be made here. In a common celebration, a penitential act may follow.
ordinary.blessing:
May the almighty Lord grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.
R/ Amen.
ordinary.te_deum:
We praise thee, O God: *
  we acknowledge thee to be the Lord.
All the earth doth worship thee, *
  the Father everlasting.
To thee all Angels cry aloud, *
  the Heavens, and all the Powers therein.
To thee Cherubin and Seraphin *
  continually do cry,
Holy, Holy, Holy, *
  Lord God of Sabaoth;
Heaven and earth are full of the Majesty *
  of thy glory.
The glorious company of the Apostles *
  praise thee.
The goodly fellowship of the Prophets *
  praise thee.
The noble army of Martyrs *
  praise thee.
The holy Church throughout all the world *
  doth acknowledge thee;
The Father *
  of an infinite Majesty;
Thine honourable, true, *
  and only Son;
Also the Holy Ghost, *
  the Comforter.
Thou art the King of Glory, *
  O Christ.
Thou art the everlasting Son *
  of the Father.
When thou tookest upon thee to deliver man, *
  thou didst not abhor the Virgin's womb.
When thou hadst overcome the sharpness of death, *
  thou didst open the Kingdom of Heaven to all believers.
Thou sittest at the right hand of God, *
  in the glory of the Father.
We believe that thou shalt come *
  to be our Judge.
We therefore pray thee, help thy servants, *
  whom thou hast redeemed with thy precious blood.
Make them to be numbered with thy Saints, *
  in glory everlasting.
O Lord, save thy people, *
  and bless thine heritage.
Govern them, *
  and lift them up for ever.
Day by day *
  we magnify thee;
And we worship thy Name, *
  ever world without end.
Vouchsafe, O Lord, *
  to keep us this day without sin.
O Lord, have mercy upon us, *
  have mercy upon us.
O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us, *
  as our trust is in thee.
O Lord, in thee have I trusted: *
  let me never be confounded.
ordinary.marian@advent: Loving Mother of our Saviour, who art the ever-open gate of heaven and star of the sea, help thy fallen people who strive to rise again; thou who, to the wonder of nature, didst bring forth thy holy Creator, Virgin before and after, receiving that Ave from the mouth of Gabriel, have mercy on sinners.
ordinary.marian@lent: Hail, O Queen of heaven; hail, O Lady of the angels; hail, thou root, hail, thou gate, from whom unto the world a light has arisen. Rejoice, O glorious Virgin, lovely beyond all others; farewell, most beautiful maiden, and pray for us to Christ.
ordinary.marian@easter:
Queen of heaven, rejoice, alleluia.
For he whom thou didst merit to bear, alleluia,
has risen, as he said, alleluia.
Pray for us to God, alleluia.
